label: UKMTO: Critical
description: Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed to commercial shipping (day 100+ of the crisis that began 28 Feb 2026): only ~2 transits recorded on 7 Jun 2026 against a pre-crisis baseline of ~94/day (c.2% of normal volume). IRGC mining, boardings, USV/UAV and missile attacks and vessel seizures continue; war-risk premiums now ~8x pre-crisis with 6 P&I clubs withdrawing cover. Red Sea / Gulf of Aden re-escalated: Houthis declared a total ban on Israel-linked navigation and struck two commercial vessels (targeted on operator port-call history, not flag) on 8-9 Jun 2026 — first kinetic enforcement since the Oct 2025 pause. Most carriers retain Cape of Good Hope routing. Persistent GNSS jamming/spoofing across the Gulf and Gulf of Oman.
